verdict.rationale: Remote is a SaaS payroll and EOR platform, so whether its source is published under an open license is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence shows that it is. The mention of sample apps "you can clone or fork" covers developer boilerplate, not the product's own source, and no license is stated anywhere.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
